products.name: Picqer for Online Stores
products.type: B2B SaaS - cloud warehouse management system
products.description: The core WMS for webshops and wholesalers with their own warehouse: multi-channel orders, inventory and locations, purchasing and receiving, batch picking, packing, shipping integrations, returns, rules and reports. Plans from Team (EUR 379/month incl. 3,000 orders) to Enterprise (EUR 5,500/month incl. 75,000 orders) with per-order fees above the included volume; unlimited users and stores.

products.name: Picqer Fulfilment
products.description: WMS for fulfilment companies: client separation in one account, client-specific rules, packaging cost pass-through, batch traceability and (in development) client invoicing. Plans Fulfilment (EUR 825/month incl. 3,000 orders), Plus, Next and Max on request; no setup or per-client fees.
